title: Casio's affordable retro LF-40W digital watches with gadget-style display launch in the US
summary: Casio's LF-40W is now on sale in the US in black, blue and beige for $42.95 each. The retro digital watch has a gadget-style display with bar-shaped seconds counters and a status row. It costs about 70% more than in Japan, where it sells for ¥4,400.
